# K0 — code-reviewer agent and .editorconfig

@@ output/template/.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md ;; Agent (delegated by the main session).
@scope agent code-reviewer (delegated review)
1 IM ;; Frontmatter delimiter.
2-3 IM ;; Agent name and routing description.
4 OL [wf010.agent-disallowed]
5-7 IM ;; Preloads the code-review skill; frontmatter delimiter.
9 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, owner, loading metadata).
11 NN ;; Heading.
13 OL [wf010.read-only]
14 OL [wf010.canonical-procedure]
15 OL [wf010.output-format]

C wf010.agent-disallowed OL WF-010 ENFORCED ;; The code-reviewer agent disallows Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit. ;; = ;; Shell tools are not disallowed. ;;
C wf010.read-only OL WF-010 MUST_NOT ;; Perform an independent read-only review: do not edit, create or delete files and do not run commands that change the repository. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf010.canonical-procedure OL WF-010 MUST ;; code-review is the canonical procedure: read it first if not loaded and follow it from scope to output; do not redefine review criteria. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf010.output-format OL WF-010 MUST ;; Return findings to the caller in the code-review output format. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.editorconfig ;; Formatting and code-style configuration (IDE, dotnet format, analyzers).
@scope all files (.editorconfig; C# rules for *.cs)
1 NN ;; Banner comment (kind, scope, owner, loading metadata).
2 IM ;; root = true.
4-15 EX [x.ec-formatting]
17 IM ;; [*.cs] section header.
18 NN ;; Comment heading.
19 OL [run024.ec-file-scoped]
20-21 EX [x.ec-usings-order]
22 NN ;; Comment naming IDE0005 and the verify completion check.
23 OL [run010.ec-ide0005]
25 NN ;; Comment heading.
26-28 EX [x.ec-var]
30 NN ;; Comment heading.
31-34 EX [x.ec-modern-syntax]
36 NN ;; Comment heading.
37-38 EX [x.ec-braces]
40 NN ;; Comment heading with conventions pointer.
41-51 EX [x.ec-naming]
53-59 OL [run024.ec-async-suffix]

C x.ec-formatting EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; UTF-8 charset, final newline, trimmed trailing whitespace (not in Markdown), space indentation of 4 (2 for JSON/YAML/TS/HTML/SCSS/CSS/project/XML/config files). ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete formatting settings not in the oracle.
C run024.ec-file-scoped OL RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; File-scoped namespace declarations are suggested for C#. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ec-usings-order EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; System directives sorted first; using directives placed outside the namespace (suggestion). ;; = ;; none ;; Using-placement settings not in the oracle.
C run010.ec-ide0005 OL RUN-010 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; IDE0005 (unnecessary using directives) is reported as a warning. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ec-var EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; var suggested when the type is apparent; not enforced for built-in types or elsewhere (silent). ;; = ;; none ;; var style settings not in the oracle.
C x.ec-modern-syntax EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Primary constructors (silent), collection expressions, switch expressions and pattern matching are suggested. ;; = ;; none ;; Modern-syntax preferences not in the oracle.
C x.ec-braces EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Open braces on new lines; braces suggested when multiline. ;; = ;; none ;; Brace/layout settings not in the oracle.
C x.ec-naming EX RUN-009,RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; PascalCase for types and members and camelCase for parameters and locals (suggestion). ;; = ;; none ;; Naming rules not in the oracle.
C run024.ec-async-suffix OL RUN-024 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Methods with the async modifier are suggested to end in Async. ;; = ;; Applies to async-modifier methods only. ;;
